quests.instruction: What is the name for all the clothes we put on together for one day? It is also the set of clothes we choose each morning before we start our day, but it is NOT your mittens!
quests.hint: It is the name for ALL your clothes together!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Outfit is the name for the whole set of clothes you wear together!
quests.funFact: An outfit is a complete set of clothes selected to be worn together.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our feet when we walk outside. It is also worn before we tie the laces or fasten the straps, but it is NOT your sandals. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: They have soles that touch the ground.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Shoes protect your feet when you walk, run, and play outside!
quests.funFact: Cleats are special shoes with spikes worn for sports like soccer.

quests.instruction: What is the name for the snug strip of fabric that circles the very top of our pants? It is also the strip that can be stretchy elastic or a stiffer strip with a button, but it is NOT your zipper!
quests.hint: This is a small feature sewn onto something bigger!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Waistband is the snug strip of fabric at the top of pants, around your waist!
quests.funFact: The waistband is the strip of fabric that wraps around your waist on pants or skirts.

quests.instruction: We wear this to bed every night before we go to sleep. It is also worn instead of our regular clothes once bedtime arrives, but it is NOT your bathrobe. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You change into these right before a story and sleep.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Pajamas are soft and comfy, made for wearing all night while you sleep!
quests.funFact: Flannel pajamas are incredibly warm for cold winter nights.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this for a fun dress-up party or a school play, not your apron. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It could turn you into a superhero or a dragon.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Costume lets you dress up and pretend to be someone or something fun!
quests.funFact: People wear costumes to perform in plays, movies, or for Halloween.

quests.instruction: We wear this at the beach or on a sunny car ride. It is also worn to keep the strong sunlight from hurting our eyes, but it is NOT your uniform. What is it?
quests.hint: They protect your eyes from bright light!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sunglasses shade your eyes so bright sunlight does not hurt them!
quests.funFact: They block invisible ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun.

quests.instruction: We wear this that sits at our collar, tied into a neat little bow shape. It is also worn for a very fancy party, tied just below our chin, but it is NOT your cape. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It sits right at your collar.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Bow Tie is tied into a small bow shape at the collar for a fancy look!
quests.funFact: They are traditionally worn with very formal suits called tuxedos.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this shaped like a simple square with a hole for our head, not your raincoat. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It drapes loosely over your shoulders.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Poncho is a simple piece with a head-hole that drapes over your shoulders!
quests.funFact: Traditional ponchos were woven from wool to keep people warm in the mountains.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that is tough enough for climbing trees and playing outside, not your pants. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are strong enough for climbing and rough play.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Jeans are made from tough denim, strong enough for climbing and rough play!
quests.funFact: They were originally invented as strong work pants for miners in 1873.

quests.instruction: We wear this before we go surfing, diving, or swimming in a chilly sea. It is NOT your life jacket. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It covers your whole body snugly!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: It works by trapping a very thin layer of water against your skin to warm it up.

quests.instruction: We wear this that babies often wear, snapped closed under their legs. It is NOT your swimsuit. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is all one piece, from top to bottom!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: They are very popular for babies because they are comfortable and stay in place.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part of a jacket our hand pokes out of at the end? It is not your pocket!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is a part, not a whole piece of clothing!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: Long sleeves keep you warm, while short sleeves keep you cool.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this made of soft, stretchy, knitted material, not your helmet. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It covers your ears completely.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Beanie is a snug knitted hat with no brim, keeping your whole head warm!
quests.funFact: They are designed to keep your head very warm in the winter.

quests.instruction: We wear this over our ears, connected by a padded band across our head. It is also worn on a freezing, windy day to keep our ears from hurting, but it is NOT your hat. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: They look a little like headphones.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Earmuffs cover just your ears with a padded band, keeping them warm!
quests.funFact: They were invented in 1873 by a 15-year-old boy whose ears got too cold while ice skating.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that is made of rubber to keep every drop of water out, not your sandals. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They keep your socks completely dry.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Rain Boots are made of waterproof rubber, keeping your feet dry in puddles!
quests.funFact: They are often called 'Wellingtons' or 'gumboots' in different countries.

quests.instruction: We wear this that has no sleeves at all, just two thin straps. It is also worn instead of a T-shirt, when even short sleeves feel too warm, but it is NOT your sweatshirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Think about this: It keeps your arms totally cool.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Tank Top has no sleeves at all, keeping your arms cool on hot days!
quests.funFact: They are extremely popular to wear on the beach or during a hot summer day.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this when it is not cold enough for a thick winter coat, not your poncho. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It is much lighter than a winter coat.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Windbreaker is thin and light, yet still blocks a gusty breeze!
quests.funFact: They are usually made of synthetic materials like nylon.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this that ties around our waist and neck to catch spills, not your shoes. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It catches spills and splatters before they hit your clothes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Apron ties over your clothes to protect them from spills and splashes!
quests.funFact: Chefs wear thick aprons to protect themselves from hot splashes in the kitchen.

quests.instruction: Think carefully: we wear this so a whole soccer team looks matching during a game, not your costume. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It usually has the same colors as everyone else's.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: Police officers, firefighters, and nurses all wear uniforms to be easily recognized.

quests.instruction: We wear this for a fancy outfit, worn over a collared shirt. It is also worn over a shirt, but with no sleeves at all, but it is NOT your cardigan. What is it?
quests.hint: It has no sleeves at all!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Vest covers your chest with no sleeves, so your arms stay free!
quests.funFact: A sweater vest can keep your chest warm while leaving your arms cool.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is soft, warm, and easy to slide on. It is also worn instead of shoes, right after we wake up in the morning, but it is NOT your socks. What is it?
quests.hint: They are soft and worn indoors, not outside!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Slippers are soft and easy to slide on, perfect for relaxing at home!
quests.funFact: They keep your feet warm when walking on cold tile or wood floors.

quests.instruction: We wear this on our legs to keep them warm. It is also worn under a dress or skirt sometimes for extra warmth, but it is NOT your skirt. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You wear a belt to help hold these up.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Trousers are another word for pants, often used for formal wear.

quests.instruction: We wear this that we change for a clean pair every single day. It is also worn first, before we put on our shirt and pants, but it is NOT your earmuffs. What is it?
quests.hint: It is worn first, under everything else!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: It protects your outer clothes from sweat and keeps you comfortable.

quests.instruction: We wear this that laces up snugly before gym class or a race. It is also worn with soft, bouncy soles that cushion every step, but it is NOT your rain boots. What is it?
quests.hint: They are made for running and jumping!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: They got their name because the rubber soles let you 'sneak' around silently.

quests.instruction: We wear this that hangs down from our waist. It is also worn instead of pants, with a shirt on top, but it is NOT your leggings. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: It swishes when you walk or twirl.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: They allow for a lot of movement and airflow on hot days.

quests.instruction: We wear this around our neck to keep cozy and warm. It is also worn with our coat on the coldest days of the year, but it is NOT your bow tie. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: It keeps icy wind off your neck.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Knitting a scarf is often the very first project for beginners.

quests.instruction: We wear this to keep each finger warm and toasty. It is NOT your waistband. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They go on your hands!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Knights used to wear heavy metal gloves called gauntlets.

quests.instruction: We wear this that is knitted from soft, warm yarn. It is NOT your cardigan. What is it?
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It is soft, warm, and often knitted!
quests.explanation: Hooray! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: The first sweaters were worn by fishermen to protect them from the cold ocean.

quests.instruction: We wear this on the top part of our body. It is also worn first, before we put a jacket on over it, but it is NOT your earmuffs. What is it?
quests.hint: Hint: You tuck this into your pants sometimes.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Shirts are traditionally made of woven fabrics like linen or cotton.

quests.instruction: We wear this when we walk on warm sand near the ocean, but it is not your boots. What is it?
quests.hint: They have straps instead of covering your whole foot.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: They consist of a flat sole held to the foot by straps.
